Watman, Trumball and Donison, the first I was positive too; that the reserved rent was 10s per ten to the Riddells, the 10 groats to the lessees, but off any to either I could say nothing. That continued for several years and does to this day, but by what authority I knew not. That some years ago when the colliery drew near , Mr Johnson thought it for the interest off it to remove the way and lay it to the Rock steath and gives warning off £40 lease; att the off which we were disturbed by the 24. But some time after Mr took a new one from the vestry off , gave us the liberty off it and have ever since bin protected by him in the peacable without even so much as the least acknowledgment. That about 1708 the said being desirous to try his fortune in the upper seams, applied himself to Mr Rogers, one off the original partners, who told him that he should be assured off his consent but refused att first to sign his consent, by reason that he was satisfied that and family would oppose him. Upon which the said made application to and the said and obtained their approbation that the said should work as Trumball had don, but upon carrying the said writing to Mr , he then recalled his promise and refused to sign. That the said promised to pay the like rent etc; that I did believe he had discharged the same yearly. Now my good friend I find that paper which we signed to you rises up in against me. I should be glad off a copy; I don't remember perfectly, but as near as I can guess what we discoursed you about was an intimation to the family that you were the person whom we approved off preferable to any, and whom we should not oppose if they let it to you, or to that effect. Now I must conjure you in the first place to secrecy, show nobody this but committ it to the flames; in the next must request off you to set me to rights if in any I am wrong, and as speedily as you can, as also what rents you have paid, when and to whom. I again entreat you to lend me your assistance att this dead lift. I am sadly uneasy in mind, because I find it gives a friend off ours great disturbance in Red Street and the rather since a good deal lies att my door. I flatter my self with a speedy return to this, otherwise I shall look upon my self as forsaken by my old friend. Excuse this trouble att a time that I know your hands are full of business, and believe me to be ... If you be a party in bill, in your answer would it not be proper to own yourself to the family, as those to whom you rent, without mentioning the partners or any off them? Pray did you show any body that piece off paper and I signed and to whom?

20th 1713 My kind friend's letter off the 15th inst came safe. I must own it was an agreeable surprise to me to find (after so many months interruption) the correspondence with my old friend revived: I read his letter over and over again, each line affording me fresh satisfaction save that which gives so sad an account of his own indisposition, which I hope att least heartily wish may be removed ere this arrive. In the mean time take a word off advice, that as this campaign has bin a long and toilsome one, those that have bin most exposed should solace themselves in their winter quarters and take care to recruit spring. has given you an account off what passed in Chancery att the last motion, where your adversaries were obliged, though with utmost reluctance, to comply to a trial att . is sadly mortified and it has bin spread about att Gate that the , despairing off success in the county, was resolved to try if he could prevail with the court to remove the issue to where he expected to find more friends in the jury; that Tom Shaftoe, being sensible off the injury he had don Sir and , was resolved to drop his cause and give them no farther trouble; that the aim was only to ruin poor , however that he did not despair off succeeding att long run. This is the language off the Gate, and just now one is come in who happened to be in company last night att att the Tavern, where that was pretty full off and declared that Mr Pitts was to putt in something into court that night which would be off singular use to his cause and he hoped would overthrow all his enemies. He entertained the dealers with a sight of a waggon way in frame, 3 in length, and a little waggon carrying a bushel of coals. He is att tavern all day with dealers in one room, the crimps and undertakers in another, and the 3d for . These leeches suck him dry and yet don't answer his ends: they demand 18d a for what they take off, without being bound to a quantity. This perplexes him so extremely, he is weary off the town and talks off leaving it in a day or two. N. B. This minature off a waggon and the way was up by sea in order to have shown to the Committee (if opportunity offered) thereby demonstrating att once the excessive that attends coal owners, and therefore an to them to grant readily a bill for settling off way leaves att a reasonable rate. This notable machine has laid concealed in a box att the Salutation ever since which is about a 12 month ago as I take it. However I shall leave that gentleman where I found him (viz.) att the Gate and proceed to the answer off yours. What relates to concern is exactly answerable to my notions. You have drawn it into a very narrow compass, into the 4 following heads: 1st either by managing the Gate, or 2dly give way to the fitters, or 3dly go on as we have don this year, or 4thly lye in for good and all. Excuse if I don't begin and say a word according to the division off my text. I begin with the last first. By lying in our rents must sink att least 1/3d, so that we must proceed while we can but even save our selves or have but a fair prospect off so doing. The 3d point is in a great measure answered in the 4th. I doubt we have bin losers and that considerably too; besides a constant fatigue to Mr and other friends below, as well as to me above, I must needs say, such a one as I can't undergo without hazard to my life. To the 2d, one had better fall into the hands off the than those off the fitters; they have scraped all the flesh off and left us to pick the bare bones. Besides when we come into their clutches we never know the expense off the trade till the year ends, and then it is too late to redress. Gift grows apace by their crafty and false representations, and still under a pretence off acting only as our neighbours doe. Which makes me call to mind when I went to school at Sir Kayes's, we used to attend upon the warren keeper to see the diversion off cony catching. He happened to catch a couple off poll cats in his trapps one night summons us boys to be witnesses to the execution, which was after this manner. He got a riddle, putt their tails through, after got a cloven stick and by that means pinched them cruelly; the poor creatures fell to fighting as long as they had breath, and after returned till they scratched their eyes out and att last lost their lives. Don't you think that the man who had his hand on the other side the riddle, with his 2 sticks, was not something related to a certain generation off people who sport att the ruin off those they get their daily food by, besides what some of them horde up. Therefore I had rather throw my self into the hands off the Gate, which though they be not off the same species, yet not unlike in qualifications; with this distinction only, that they pick your pocket but they tell you before hand the sum will be, whereas the other slides his hand into your purse, takes and takes again and yet will not bear a reprooff. I own that off 2 evils the least ought to be chose and therefore doe agree with my good friend that the first off the 4 is more preferable. But then how will this matter be compassed; not so easily as one would imagine. We have so offed cracked our words with them in relation to the quality off our coals: any time these 3 years we promised that the coals should come roundier and better than for several by past, and yet when there they prove every year smaller than others, nay even to this very last voyage. Here were 9 or 10 off their ships all in a manner together; 4 or 5 are but their bulks proving so excessively small that they have entirely ruined the markett, for the other ships off that concern that had not sold are not offered a farthing. The masters run about the Gate like so many crazed people; they bellow, swear and forswear every voyage that they will not be slaves to their fitters, that they will be damned before they will load again. Now you see in what a condition we are in. Dealers, masters and fitters are prejudiced to the utmost degree. As to the first, would you promise them 2s a if they come as they did this last year, they will not take it. Nay most off the middling having burnt their fingers the beginning off the year, shun them as if infected, which will appear by the account I writ to Mr and off what each dealer has don, and shall send the now att when the whole vend will be made up. There is scarce any that could vend a quantity but Dawson, Godfrey and the 2 Oldners, and all those went to the glass houses. Now suppose we were assured off all that vend it would not to 5000 the yearly consumption, and I hear that Brummell has secured Godfrey by a of no less than 12d, perhaps more, and a good commodity which will vend it self. How can we therefore propose to doe the same by our concern, which has had the worst reputation off any that comes to markett? Jack, Mr man, is come up to town. In case any off our ships happen to deliver this next week, I will prevail with his to let him go aboard a day or more, that he may be satisfied how they work out. This boy tells me they have the roundest ship coal in the river off Tine att pitts. To which I replied, Jack if you had such a stock off choice, it had not bin amiss if you had sent up 3 or 4 off the last bulks for a specimen off what they might expect the next year, but instead off that we have the worst that has come this year. What can I say to them? Or doe you think they will believe me? No, were I to confirm it even with an oath. Reputation may when once gained be easily preserved, but when that is sunk, it is nothing but length off time that can retrieve. However I will try the dealers separately (for they refuse to treat jointly with or for any concern); I will see what they say but despair off success. I could wish that Mr (to whom I desire the contents of this may be communicated) affairs would give him leave to take a trip up to town, that we might jointly transact what is to be done att the Gate: why might not he come and spend the holy days with us? He that is upon the spott and has seen the working off the coals, I say his words and assurances may perhaps have a greater influence on the dealers. I still continue off my old opinion, that unless the western people be not kept within bounds, that is blown up and many others not a little distressed. I know it has bin proposed by Mr Pitt's agent to Roberts, who was Shallot's partner and always had his Tanfield Moor, to work 20000 to which reply was made, then that gentleman must advance his in proportion to the . Brummell att the same time proposed to work at least 20000 or 25000 ; this last was made to several off the number ten, who were ready to engage to doe their utmost but then would have 1s 6d for what ever they helped off with. In short they don't know how to ask enough. Several had the assurance to ask 1s for but nothing was complied with by either side, nor any offer made by us save 3d as usual. This is a secret and must not be disclosed. Besides they would not oblige themselves for any quantity. My father received yours. He has had a return off his drowsiness within this week by past, which unfits him to answer yours, therefore desires you will excuse him for a post or two and the first clear day he will set about it. We have had such continual fogs as one could cut with a knife, which has affected me not a little as you may guess by this confused letter, but a word to you is enough. You have a return off my best thanks for your kind remembrance off me. Pray make my humble service acceptable to the honest , his lady and your Ramsay; to all I wish health and prosperity, and in a particular manner to you and yours being with all sincerity, honest ...

29th 1713 Yours with the enclosed bill for thirty pounds came safe to hand on Christmas day. Your kind and obliging remembrance shall not be forgot, and depend upon it your health is frequently drank by your friends here when you don't think off it. Lord never fails of doing it whenever and wherever we meet, not even excepting the College. I am sorry you give no better an account of your ; should you drop or even the infirmities off body should render you incapable of transacting business, from that very day should I date the declension off our trade. You are the only man that can keep the knott together, which has bin cracking a great while. Twixt us two, but let not this go any farther, I find a strong inclination in a certain gentleman to dissolve the present union, as I may so call it. I write to him this post and desired he would communicate it to you and take your advice. I likewise desired he would excuse me till the next post to you, but as I have 1/4 of an hour to the good, I thought I could not employ my self better than by a short conversation with you. I find my successor and he can't set up there horses together, neither has he any great opinion off Daniell's management; this is what I gather now and then from small and dark hints. I could heartily wish that you would let me a little into those secrets, with your remark upon them. From I have not had a line this month or more. I could freely part with 5 guineas for an evening or two with you hand to fist; I dare say that it would be off greater benefit to bodily health than all the physic for this 12 month by past, as well as an to the mind. I acquainted Mr Sanderson with your commission, who said it was very well. He poor man was not so att that time having eat something the night before that did not digest, but is better since. Now my good friend my time is near expired. I hope he will excuse me if I remind him off putting the finishing stroke to his account off waggon way. The particulars off wood and as I take it were formerly in; what then remains but fixing a gratification answerable to the trouble you were att and the services don the concern. Make your own demands; I dare engage my word no body will gainsay . You can't imagine what a great sufferer I may be by the delay off our accounts not passing, and as I am informed, they can't close the year 1711 till they have that article off yours. Let me entreat you therefore to finish that offhand, by which I shall be perfectly made easy and you will thereby lay me under the greatest obligations. Adieu my good friend, let no body see this and believe me to be ...

15th Kind friend, I justly call you such because I frequently partake off your purse, as well as other good things. The cargo off French was safely laid into my cellar about a fortnight ago. That very day Lord and Tom Day surprised my father att dinner without giving the least intimation in the afternoon sent to me to keep them company. They then discovered the secret, which was their intention off drinking an afternoon bottle with me, which I encouraged. Accordingly they came to my house and my lord who has his eyes about him spied my cargo in the yard; began to examine what they were and whence they came, to which I gave direct answer. Oh says he, if they came from our friend I am entitled to a bottle and one I will have. It was set upon the table and his began your health the first. The whole company brought in their verdict unanimously that it was a wine off a good body and flavor but that it was not in its full perfection, being almost chilled with the cold weather, therefore advised to keep it a month att least before I went farther. You can't imagine how fond my lord was off it, insomuch that I had much ado to screen it though I gave them the very choicest off last summer's importation. This lays me under very singular obligations and what adds to them still was the passing the way accounts, for it was want off that which putt a stop to our passing our accounts, at least pretended to be such. Nay Johnson since yours wrote me word that the accounts were very and he did not see when yours and Mr would be delivered in; therefore told me plainly that if his were not passed in court, he neither could nor would serve the concern longer. But this I desire may go no farther. I have not been negligent in reminding my father frequently off and the wayleave; nay I fail not to press him. You know his slow way off acting and indeed having multiplicity off business upon his hands, one breaking in upon another, added to his state of health, all putt together perfectly distracts him. For instance, there is an unsettled account twixt him and my uncle ever since my grandfather's death, which in case off either off their demise would involve my uncle's and our family in suits and controversies without number. Mr Freak foreseeing this had 2 or 3 meetings some months since and yet not quite brought a conclusion. However in this case of ours (for so I call etc.) I have made him sensible that since your only design in making those troublesome steps were for his and family's advantage, and how you had withstood very profitable offers which you could not well answer to your family, that he ought to declare himself openly if he would comply or att least that you should not loose the opportunity off making the best off your interest. To which he replied, you say right; I am under very great obligations to that true friend, I shall always acknowledge his favours, pray remind me from time to time, you know my infirmities, my head is seldom free an hour in a day. I have drawn out some short heads for the way leaves which I will show to Mr and get him to digest into form. Now my good friend, since I have his leave I will pursue him close till we bring matters to a crisis. Would it not be most proper do you think, that we get the lease off the way first executed or att least ready that off the coal lease? Depend upon it I will not be idle and from time to time you shall have an account off the success. Give me leave to rejoice with you on that this week before the Lord off which I doubt not you have heard by letter from , whom I have not seen since, he going out of town the day after but expected back this night. I long for that long letter you promised me, which will give me insight into matters as well as persons. I am a perfect stranger to what passes with you; be therefore so free with me as to explain what and who are the chief occasions off your grievances. You may rest assured that where you enjoin a secret, it shall never be divulged to any living soul. What you think proper to be communicated to my father, let it be as it were in a letter by it self. What relates to Fenham he told me he had wrote to you about it, and ordered me to do the like to the which he leaves to yours and his transaction. I wish he would doe the like in the cases of the 2 leases to yourself and ... My humble service to the and Mrs .

16th 1713/4 The sudden alteration off weather from one extreme to another has had a strange effect upon me. All the last week was violently afflicted with a cold rheum which fell upon my gumms and gave a sharp taste off an infirmity to which I was all along a stranger, and that was the tooth work. I got little or no rest for 4 nights successively, though made use off 2 doses off opium to procure it. Att last ventured to pull a tooth last Friday, and the day following was obliged to dine in Red Lyon Street. Got back by 6 found my self much out off order; twixt 9 and 10 grew very bad, my tongue failed me, had no strength in my limbs, my eyes were contorted, I could scare see any body. In short it was a palsy or apoplectic fit, though not to the degree off that I had last spring. The surgeon was sent for att 11 and took away 18 or 20 ounces off blood, after which I came to my self and have bin confined to the house ever since. This day the ordered me some physic and to morrow hope to make my father the first visit, though the pain and swelling in my mouth still continues. These frequent relapses prey upon my constitution much disorders the whole fabric; I find my self considerably weakened and not capable off undergoing many such shocks, and as for business worse than ever. However as opportunity offers I am still ready to exert my self for the service of my friend. Accordingly have wrote to to sollicitt 3 off his neighbours and acquaintance who are upon the special jury to attend the view, and my father undertakes to confirm either by this or the next post. I told him that our friends had no to request but that off a personal appearance, and trusted the issue to the justice off the cause. All the agents off the adverse party look with a desponding countenance; nay even their former Billingsgate advocates alter their language, I mean the Dons. Major Loggin who has brought up a bulk off Mr Pitt's Tanfield had sold for 34s but they soon dropped to 30, after to 29 and 28, nay I believe 27s. He has bin parcelling out near 3 weeks and was not quite last night. There is but one ship off Bucks Nook. Rob forced Blunkett to the tavern and engaged him to take off the bulk, some say att 28s, others say 27s, but I believe she will not be expeditiously dispatched, for there is no demand and the 11s coals are fallen to to 26, whereas had the ships forbore coming 3 weeks longer they would have met with a topping price and dispatch. I thank you for the advice you gave in yours to . I had a letter from the north the post before I think, with an account that you had in your ; that the tenn amounted to above 20s, which was thought very high considering that it was offered to be taken att 14s and that I had refused Jimmy to let him have it att 16s, thinking the latter price . Though this was not expressly mentioned yet it was referred to my memory. Your reasons off the increase off charge were added; in my answer I added another you had omitted, which was the difficulties you struggled with att your entering upon the business by the old workmen, waggon men and agents, when they did what in them lay to destroy the foundations you had laid, besides loss off timber by pilferers etc. I advised my friend to discourse over the matter with you calmly, and withal I ventured to assure him that in case any article seemed to bear hard upon us, I did not in the least doubt but you would rectify it. And further that as you were capable off serving the concern in other respects to the advantage off our pupil we might depend upon your good offices and wholesome advice. The post after I had another with account that there was due to you as which I must own surprised me, for according to your calculation you have not had for above 2 instead off 4 years. I am sure that in my hands there remains but about £700 att present, having fairly accounted to the latter end of the year 1713. Out off this I am daily paying the maintenance of the 3 misses and our pupil, besides with the dealers and as they become due. I have this satisfaction that we shall have in our accounts before the Master sometime next term to the year 1714. And as my wife could not act as guardian since her marriage, our pupil has chose and prevailed with Mr Freak to accept off that office, one who will not favour any party but push things on without delay. I must own I have not bin easy this 2 or 3 years but hope shortly shall be so. I am free and open with you. I disclose the secrets off my heart but it is to a person in whom I can confide. Therefore desire you will not take the least notice off anything herin contained but committ to the flames. I wish you a good journey and that it may be crowned with the desired success. My humble service to Mrs . Adieu ... for English salt abroad, wheroff I hope my friend has a share. When the York assize is over and you a little recruited, should be glad to know how our joint talent improves. If I can meet a favourable opportunity shall present you with a couple off Steel's last Englishmen, wherein he takes a handsome leave off his readers.

1st 1714 I am this minute returned from the Gate, consequently you may judge not very fit for this employ, however can't omit adding a word. showed me your letter off particulars what had already and what you apprehended would occur since the trial. I had an account from honest Wait's mouth off what passed 'tween the judge and Sir he being then present, and his opinion was that the judge lent an ear to the but could not say that he made any impression. We advised with Mr on this subject (though not in time to impart for the affair would be over before a letter could reach your hand); his opinion was that none off you should appear att the sitting, so that you might avoid thereby giving the Chancellor any opportunity off soliciting a reference. However in my poor sense of matters, the course you have pursued is the best; as also engaging Berrisford and the favourite in your interest was a prudent forecast. What they are procuring by numbers off hands at will make a noise, but from the Gate I hear not a syllable, neither doe we think it advisable to touch upon it; when we hear off their motions we must watch them narrowly. As to , he is a cunning crafty ; I don't say that he would not receive a sum, but att the same time underhand he would be as active as any off them in promoting any thing that had a seeming tendency off advantage to the new concern. I have ofter than heard from good hands that he, Sir , Oldner and Blunkett were the people who have all along supplied your neighbours (though not friends) with considerable sums, with a prodigious interest; nay and that some off the above named had actually advanced them some hundreds even after the last defeat. At this rate to support the extravagancys, that mine ought to have bin a silver one instead off coal. It is absolutely carried against feeing Sir Peter, for says the Philosopher, he will not take one, but thinks it reasonable that he should be thoroughly apprised off the matter and then he will engage he will doe what service he can. And my proposal is that if we find the great Dons stirring att the Gate, we must try if we can't get the reverse with the hands off the middling ones, who are greater in numbers though not in bulk. This last is my own project. I think I have touched upon the most material points off yours. I am certain your pains are indefatigable, your and superior to any that I ever knew, and I doubt not but will be in due time crowned with success. Company is come in to see me which is not a little perplexing. Give me leave to add a word more. I design shortly to enclose for your perusal the new copy off lease. Suppose the has or will shortly have the like from honest : we leave any to you and the . This my father told me that the next month he designed for the north that the way leave should be made easy; making use off this expression, that it was for the use and benefit off his own family chiefly and one particular friend more, by name Mr which he reckoned next to his own; that it was necessary to satisfy my sister on that point, which he would effect the very first thing after his arrival. Adieu, Signor waits impatiently to take this to the post. I have not time to peruse what I have wrote; am sure I am to my good friend ...

May 13th I am got abroad again after a fatiguing illness, the effects off which I find hangs upon me still, that is to say the feavor has not quite left me. I have yours to Jimmy last post, it lies before me. Don't take it amiss if I pretend to answer part off it, because that gentleman is busy taking leave off his friends. I fancy he will decamp about Monday and comes down by sea, but not a syllable must be mentioned on pain off excomunication. I have perused along with your exploits. He approves what you have don, as must all your friends; he says you and he will lay them flatt upon their backs. He wants mightily the bill off costs from below that he may get them taxed without loss of time. I can assure you our friends high and low in the of are pretty numerous, insomuch that Mr and his party have not thought fit to make any motion as yett. As matters stand att present we don't apprehend their succeeding, though they may give us trouble enough. What you mention about certifying the stocks off coals resting att each steath att would be very useful to know. It was what I wrote to the to get don above a week since, that is for and ; have spoke to Mr to write to Weatherly and Lowry about that of . Must leave to your procuring those off and , and , Jesmond, that off the Grand Lease if to be had, as also the prices each concern sold for, which must be returned up with convenient speed. It would be no difficult matter to prevail with the masters to certify, if occasion, that the occasion off scarcity off coals last year was soly to be attributed to the lowness of price that commodity gave att this markett the beginning off the year, which occasioned numbers off the greatest ships seek out foreign freights. But I believe there will be no necessity for such a certificate, att least till we see farther. Coltman, Bennett and Blunkett are the only furious advocates against the proceedings. I believe they have most reason, being as I am informed deeply soused; the latter would not speak a word to any body att the Gate this day is morose to a degree. But was inquiring very lately what estate Mr had, where it lay and so forth, but received no satisfactory answer. The 2 Oldners are tolerably easy and for ought I know have slipped their neck out off the halter, which perhaps was owing to a hint a friend off yours gave them 2 or 3 months since. Will Robinson be able to show his head speedily? If he did not and if the be in a manner excluded, then I must advise all our friends to slip no opportunity off leading down to the steaths what quantities they can possibly, so that there be no clamour for want off coals to supply the ships. seems apprehensive that his way will be pulled up and several others, but I propose that those which are not should contribute to the charge equally, being for a public advantage; and I do imagine that if this was made to him, it would remove his apprehensions and induce him to continue firm in the opposition. Nevill Ridly was att the Lobby the the petition was to be presented, but what interest he had made or who were his friends he did not impart to any off our friends. I can tell you who exerts himself against us, that is Tom Gibson, and were it not for his interest they would be able to make but an figure. I need to tell you no more off our interest with the Torys than that Lord Lansdown told an acquaintance off mine last he was assured that if any Member in the county off Cornwall should be for the petition, he was certain they must never think being chose again, for there they were as choice off their properties and made as much by way leaves as any people whatever. Chopwell coal is in great demand here, notwithstanding I can but join with your notion about letting if feasible, att a moderate quantity. I must leave to Jimmy to transact that matter with the gentlemen here. I long to see Frank ; he was the other day to pay a visit to Red Street. Last night we melted down yours, the and Ellison's tokens att Jenny Man's, where was Lord , , Allinson with many friends. We drank all your healths; retired soon after ten, though some did not part till it smote little ones. Adieu. Take care off your own health, which I am sorry to find so very fickle and uncertain ... I design when I see to read over lease with him if he can spare so much time and after trust it to his conveyance to you. My father salutes you.

May 20th 1714 I begin with that part off my kind friend's letter which affects me most and putts me into the deepest concern, to have from his own hand such a melancholy account off his health. I could not rest till I had hunted out the ; read him your complaints off the cough and hoarseness that stuck so close by you. To have enabled him to have made a complete prescription, he was wishing you had bin more particular in your account, but as he is no stranger to your habitt off body he has promised to send me his thoughts by this post. I spoke to the about you last night in the presence off Mr Freak who has bin troubled with a cough as violent as ever I knew for several years; we thought it would have carried him off about a fortnight ago. You must know he is no friend to the apothecary's shop but leaves nature to work its own way, but att last was prevailed with to take some pills off Barbados tar, or where that is not to be had common tar, made up after the following manner with the following powders. Take powders off ores and alicampane a like quantity, powders off liquorish double quantity. Mix them together and after roll the tar till it comes to the substance that it will make a pill. Take 10 or 12 in a day or more. It is extremely balsamic and has recovered Mr Freak to a miracle in less than a fortnight's time. He has known many others recovered by the same without any other application. He recommends it to you from his own experience. I will get some off the Barbados tar and send it you down by the first opportunity. My father had the 3 packetts from Lord with the 6 enclosed papers; no more are since come to hand. By what I can learn we shall hear no more off the petition this sessions. It is the generally opinion off both high and low. However it is our business not to lye dormant but be upon the guard. has attempted I believe several times to wait on Sir especially att the House, yet has never had the good luck to meet with him. And he must not pretend to it now because that gentleman is gon to the races att Guilford and Bansted Downs, but will do it the beginning off the week and it must be my business to remind him. I have not seen him since Monday night when he took leave off Jimmy att my father's, where were abundance off your friends att supper, among the rest canny Frank who not knowing off this invitation came to pass the evening att my house. He and I had half an hour's discourse before we went to Red Street and are to fix an afternoon this week, when he will be free from Lord business, when we are to solace ourselves. Jimmy went on board Mark Noble the next day but that is to be kept secret. My father sends you 6 off his best chocolate by Jimmy. Your servant's which came to hand a post or two before that which lies before me now, was communicated to none but my father. The objections you made are just and would bide a strict eye to survey them. My father longs to be with you had bin ere this had it not bin for the petition, which he can't forbear attending. We are this going to wait on Lord ; if anything new occur you shall have a line. P.S. The lord was not in town. I took that opportunity off visiting Baker; had him to my self during a pipe. We discoursed on several things and he has promised to come to morrow evening to complete our conversation. Att our return we found Sir Haslerigg, uncle Allanson and 2 more gentlemen that were come to dine with my father. They staid till near 8 and putt about the glass briskly. I was obliged to screen my father, so that the labouring oar fell heavy on me. I wonder Mr Poyen does not send me up the stocks att : pray desire him to doe it. The 3 persons yours mention att Gate are handsomely dipped. They begin now to say that they were drawn in and exclaim against the projectors. We are all sensible that the western concerns would cut out the whole river, I mean the old standers att least, but very few off them would be able to carry on any trade to advantage. If it would not be too much trouble to you to set case in a true light and send it to my father, he might find means to communicate it when opportunity offers. Pray excuse this imperfect answer and consider it is after a bottle and half for my share, for which I shall doe penance to morrow. I heartily wish success to the 2 doctors' prescriptions and remain ... My father when I left him charged me to assure you off his best wishes and had not I wrote, he would; but in truth he is distracted by this afternoon's expedition.

June 10th 1714 I was favored with my kind friend's letter bearing date the 4th inst in its due course. It afforded me a double satisfaction, first because your complaints off bad health are not so loud as formerly and which I am persuaded, when you have taken the Philosopher's prescription half a times, you will find sensible relief and by a perseverance will entirely remove the cause. What makes me so confident in this point is that I see daily the good effects. My father began with it this week, taking 2 pills in the morning, as many after noon and the like number before he go to bed. Has found much relief as to his cough and shortness off breath. Mrs Frances Shaftoe began much about the same time, takes but half the number and yet she owns her self better by them; though I doubt she is too far gon, being inclinable to a consumption and in a manner given over by the great Rattcliff. I mention to you only these 2 instances, as an to you to proceed. The other cause off my joy that you have so good and substantial a body off reserve in petto , wherewithal you will effectually humble the extravagant insolence off your antagonists. I can assure you they don't in the least suspect any after-game. They sleep secure without either watch or ward. This I could discover by Blunkett and some other the great Dons, who with a smiling countenance asked me yesterday att the Gate if Bucks led any coals. I replied, if they consulted their own letters they were able to answer the question themselves; that I did never correspond with any off the proprietors or agents off that concern. Oh, says , but we hear that they are still pulling up the way which lies in a lane, a known reputed high way; that these practices were executed by a Lady Hutton as they were informed. However to prevent that they were forced to keep an armed patroll by night for 3 miles together etc., a vast charge and what poor Brummell could never bear. No, I answered, without he calls in aid some off their body, who were always ready to assist the distressed and so forth; thus we bantered till after one a clock. But I must now proceed by taking leave off those master pieces off impudence, and acquaint you that you mistook a great toe for a least. My father is well off that but has had a strange hoarseness or sinking off his voice ever since Saturday, and even off that he is much better and hopes to complete by lying in the air for a fortnight; to that end has secured a lodging att Kensington, where I fancy he designs to morrow. He would not divulge a syllable off what our trusty friend communicated till I had obtained his leave for so doing and for the reasons which he will communicate. I was assured and can depend that it will be kept a secret. Perhaps some things may fall in naturally in way off discourse which may give an insight, though but a short one, and may give a handle to an enquiry. If I find my self out off order I complain, but to whom should I? Why to my friend. But as it is not in his power to relieve, ought not he go to the best off advice give some hints off my distemper that may lead the to a distant knowledge off my symptoms; who without making any discovery may point out something that may be off present service and prevent for the future. A word to the wise. Trusty left us last Monday noon, taking his rout by Oxford so that when he can reach Mr I know not. After my prescriptions for your health, my father recommends to your particular care not to travel late att night and never without some person; and sent you by our friend his own pair off pocket pistols, which he presents you with but at the same time enjoins you never to travel without them. They are clever, well made and lye in little room. I just long to hear how you will mumble poor . When I mention that name puts me in mind off our accounts. I wrote to Jimmy as formerly hinted: he took Peter to task, who has promised a care more than ordinary but that shall not doe. I will attack him likewise, for if he keeps him he shall not entrust him with a sight off our books, but twixt you and me Jimmy is more suspicious off another under his roof viz. . Don't take the least notice. That concern is under most unhappy circumstances considering the present situation. The differences twixt poor Jimmy and grow daily to a greater height, which must undoubtedly be a vast prejudice to that concern, which without them is under the greatest difficulties. This makes me frequently think off resigning and I believe shall speedily doe it. The of Durham was to go out off town this day. He generally talks off giving my father the trouble of a trial about the eastern fell but I don't hear he took notice off it yesterday when my father took leave off him. If you hear off any stirridge off that sort, you will be so kind as to impart to ...

26th 1714 After having been passed from constable to constable for about a fortnight, without much fatigue, we arrived att this place off Saturday night, where we design to take up our winter quarters. I find that as the town off Whickam in situation is much exalted above the rest off its neighbourhood, so does its zeal for the present exceed in lustre. Pray remember me kindly to those true patriots, Canny and the honest greeve, and that jolly blade who threw the priest's wife's mug into the fire (though unknown) should not be forgot. It is a pity there were not more off such public spirits dispersed over your diocese. Mr got to town 2 or 3 days before us; was att the Gate on Friday or Saturday assured the dealers that Bucksnook would after all revive, seemingly intimating as if the and he had come to terms and he hoped this next year to clear all their old demands. In short I am still off the same opinion, that it is better to end this dispute upon reasonable terms than run the hazard off a tedious contest, the determination off which must be owned uncertain. Especially considering the unsettled situation off public affairs att present and a medley it will be att best. His is off an admirable disposition, willing to doe every thing for the best. Here are great numbers off laden ships come into the river, I believe the whole fleet that was loading att when I was there. No demand, so that the price is very low, which must occasion complaints both by masters and dealers where there is no just occasion. My uncle is just come thence; he tells me off some against our Stella and they needs will have it that your coals are mixed with them, which makes the alteration. I ridiculed that wild notion as I shall doe it in person att the Gate on Thursday next. I know not but that I must trouble you with an enclosed list off the justices for our county as they stood this present year; if you know any that are fit to be added, let me know. The method this takes in adding new ones is if they be qualified with a brace off hundreds a year; I do believe there are many in the present list that will fall short. Pray how does our Farnacres drift go on? You will make an offer of my best services acceptable to our worthy landlord off Westgate , to Mrs and all friends. Adieu, I wish you all health and happiness, and rest ... I am sorry that Jackson should have come as a deputy to the controllers. I can assure you my friends have not bin awanting in their application, not for that post but some other off consequence; no success as yet but not without hopes. I charge you not to mention a syllable. I must have a speedy answer to the enclosed. My father salutes you. Just now I hear the , who has bin mightily pressed by a very great man who solicited for his friend a military , took courage and told him, my lord, I have gratified you in all your demands but am resolved in this to oblige another. If you will not, I will make my self easy. Upon which the lord retired into the country.

17th 1714/5 Doubtless after my last which carried Sunderland measure, you will admire att my impertinence in troubling you so soon again. The principal reason is that you would get the enclosed conveyed safe as directed and speedily, and the next is to salute you with a paper called the Citizens' Advice to their Representatives in if I can get one; if I should fail you will see them att large in this day's Flying Post. They will please Mr taste to a nicety, though not your on the north off your river. Perhaps you may hear that Ross, Ecklin and Hill are to keep their ; they have made their submission, it is probable, and his as he is wondrous good is pleased to continue them. I designed a visit to Lady and son yesterday with an intention to touch a little upon the borders off her concern att Hutton but both off them were so ill off colds that I had no admittance. Tried again this day but they were gon down to , I suppose to see Byron. Indeed the young gentleman I am afraid is in a very bad way; he has had a violent cough accompanied with an hoarseness that has hung upon him ever since he came to town. Would not listen to any advice, trusting to the strenght of his constitution that nature would work it off, but within a week he found himself obliged to send for a doctor; I wish he may not have future cause off repenting the delay. Last night I paid Mr Freak within a very few pounds off the second thousand, so that he has had in all off me upwards off £2030 which he has laid out in classis orders for the benefit off the Infant. I have a bill on Tom York for which I expect to receive on Monday next out off which I shall pay your bill to Mr Cay's order, and you may draw on me att sight any time next week for to Sanderson. Att the same time if you give another on the account off off my own account, I can give my self creditt for it and then I can give in a clear account to the Master; I call it clear, because I shall not have a five penny piece in my hands off the money, and that I would willingly doe that the court may see I have given a full account of what I was entrusted with. Indeed my good friend if Dan charges more than 5s for the pan coal, I think he bears hard on you. If have time shall write to him this post on that subject and answer his last. He has to my thinking strange notions off the trade; has given his opinion to lay aside the dealers entirely, to allow the masters 2s chalder and let them fight their way, by which means he proposes cutting off all charges off here. I question much if that be complied with, if it obtain the desired end. Sure I am it will be the worst off presidents that ever was brought on the trade. Will make all concerns very touchy and uneasy; this makes me remind you to see if she could be let and then the undertaker or undertakers may menage as they think fit. I frankly declare to you that those coals as they came up the 2 last voyages were as much sought after as any att Gate, always fetched within 3d off and frequently equal price. I could say more on this head but will only mention this: that Blunkett, Watts, Coltman, Bennett, when I paid them the at Christmas which was 6d , told me that if they had suspected I would have paid them as I did, that concern instead off vending 17000 should have sold 40000, and upbraided the 2 Oldners and Godfrey for not letting them into the secret. This is enough to say so I shall close all with assuring that I am ...

19th 1714/5 I am not neither have I bin these ten days in tolerable plight off health, which made me answer yours by piecemeal; sometimes I recommended half a lines to the to communicate to you, att to or Peter, as opportunity offered. I don't remember to have omitted any thing material; if I have you must attribute it to bodily infirmities. Pray what are your thoughts off my to Chopwell scheme formerly sent up signed by Dan, Peter and Weatherly? I must own I wish that concern were let for the term off 3 or 4 years and then I should be eased of a perplexing and daily trouble. Ever since Wedensday we have bin alarmed with the loss of the new ship called the Clavering and yesterday it came confirmed both by land and sea. What I mention this is upon the account off the 3 misses off that name who are great sufferers thereby, having all the household goods etc. that were left to them by their mother in that bottom, besides all the family pictures, which can never be retrieved. Poor Dick Bellassis is computed to have lost near upon £1000, he having 1/8 off the ship, all his house furniture and some say a good deal off plate and some jewels on board. I am now preparing to go along with our pupil to the Master in Chancery with our books off accounts for the year 1713, as also to get his receipt in form for the last thousand pound I paid into court, which probably a certain now on the road may be so curious as to desire a sight off. Poor man, I dread his coming up for his own sake; if he be not provided with a very considerable sum towards the discharging a good part off his balance, I don't know the consequence that will ensue unavoidably. The court has had hitherto a more than ordinary complaisance upon his account, but if there be but a weak performance off what has bin so long promised, I doubt his reception will not what he expects. But don't let this go further. The church has lost the greatest pillar and in the person off the much respected off who I hear is to be succeeded by the honest off Oxford and his post to be supplied by Dr Potter, Thom 's chaplain, to the great mortification off high . I enclose you the Dutch speech to his which you will not grudge reading, and let Mrs have the perusal of it. I can't but apprehend a very bad coal trade this year. Our joint adventure in Farnacres I wish may answer our expectation; hitherto we have had but a sour and expensive prospect. P.S. The enclosed from Denzill came to hand this afternoon and he himself followed a few hours after. Has promised to let me have a particular off the last contract on Monday next, which shall be sent you, as also will befriend you as much as in the power off a . As to your adventure off dails, I have informed my self particularly off one who has bin on the same foot with you but happened to be in 3 or 4 cargoes. His advice is by sad experience to sit down with the first loss. The has a discretionary power for both parties here concerned to act what he thinks most beneficial in relation to . I must add no more than that I am on all occasions ...

6th 1715 Your two last came safe and bring a most particular account off transactions in your parts. I do assure you they were very kindly and laid before the Secretaries by your friend off Bedford Row. They are much obliged to you for their intelligence and never see him but are inquisitive what news he has from your country, for as much as I can gather they depend more upon you than all the rest. Before I proceed must take notice that I have (pursuant to your orders) bin att the Grecian to see Mr Gibson. It was as rainy an as any we had this year. Not one off the family was there; which gave me an opportunity off transcribing that part off yours and sending it the next morning by express. This afternoon your above friend came to see me almost half drowned; tells me he has several commissions from the two Secretaries. 1st. They desire you will inform them if T. be gon over to Lord . Also that there are some English gentlemen gon lately northwards in their way to that lord as is supposed; if possible to learn their names. Pray who is the receiver general of your customs? 2ndly. They will have from you the state off with your opinion what force would be necessary to prevent any disturbance in that or your county, as also what would be requisite to secure the peace off your corporation. 3dly. You are further requested to send your thoughts freely, and that what relates to public business might be in a paper by it self that it may be kept by them to refresh their memory. And lastly I am ordered to assure you from the above mentioned parties that if any thing be to be don in relation to the troops, send word in time by making any offer and it will be complied with. I am charged not to read yours to any one body. caution you to take what care you can that your letters be not opened to the northwards. I have no reason to suspect as yet any practice off that sort; therefore you will direct as usual. I could wish to have a further account off parson Fenwick off Morpeth I think; the writes word that Sir gives him the character off a Tory. This should be sent by the first post (though I doubt it will be too late). The Duke and Lord Castlecomer espouses him strenuously for Long Horseley. I doe what I can for parson Cowper, but am not so sanguine off success as formerly because his grace is not to be putt out off humour att this time off day. There will be 6000 men from Flanders speedily. Exert yourselvs and all will go well, and no will be awanting. This is the last push off the desperate faction, which I hope when once over will settle us upon a solid foundation. Now dear friend excuse hast and believe me to be ...

1 1715 I am in concern that you should be deprived off the use off your pen, though you are so generous as to supply that defect by your deputy. Your intelligence is so much in vogue that no sooner the post come but I have great men's valets waiting for the produce off your packet. However I can assure you it is not to above two that I will trust them out off my hands; and it is a high don to those I read them too and those are very few in number. My good kinsman ever since my father came to town, as I formerly hinted, is not so zealous; he is att present a housekeeper by reason off a sore throat, but he fails not once off seeing your dispatches. Herafter I shall make use off another hand. This my father and self went to Duke off to impart he was not to be seen; thence to Mr who was not to be met with; we took Lord Somers in our return and were there also disappointed. I do imagine they were all sommond to Council. So we lost our labour. Pray send me the present supervisor's name, as also that off the person you would have succeed him. I will not let my friends rest from soliciting. Is he supervisor for our county or only our ward? Pray continue your early accounts. Our friend in the Fields has bin ill off the strangury for several days but after the post came he found him self easier, which I attribute to the good account yours brought, though is not so well this day. But don't take the least notice off his health in your return. The parson recommended by White, Foster, your and other friends has succeeded att last for Long Horseley, notwithstanding as I hear your magistrates joined in a recommendation on behalf off Willcox, Sir chaplain, which makes the obligation the greater. Att the Grecian the talk is that the Dutch forces would be embarked last Sunday, so that now they wait only the wind. The cantoning your troops as proposed, is looked upon as the produce off a solid . A report is that Butler did putt to sea ten days ago from Ambleteux not far from Calais and is said is returned back to France, finding his scheme in the west was broke. Others will have that a man off war gave chase to his ship, which obliged him to return; but of either off these reports I can't depend as what comes from the north. When things come to calm and these burlys are over, you may assure your self a lasting security may be reasonably expected. I am summoned to attend Mr and am obliged to deliver up my arms, my pen and ink, and rest to my father. Both off them are much att your service and so is ...

19th 1715 Honest and trusty Will, your last was by mistake delivered to my father which I retrieved this afternoon, when he was looking for the chapter in Ezekiell. Within the liberties off the justices have begun with their convictions by order off Counsel and had in their rolls to the clark off the peace, where it has laid sometime. An enquiry was made by the Counsel what was don by the justices and on Monday I think they design to make their representation. In Essex they began earlier, so that it is hoped these presidents will spread all over the nation. I remember my father as he read over yours, when he came to the particular off the caveat, said that was done. As to and your assistant, I must referr to my Lord who is very active and ready to serve his friends. Sir is but slow. But indeed the confusion the whole ministry and nation has bin in makes that they can't lend an ear, or if they doe it is in att one and out off the other; but now it is hoped this hurricane is over, and shortly we expect a calm and from thence that recommending a fit person to serve will be listened unto. What you propose about the militia would be of singular use att this time; they could not fail off picking up abundance off strollers, which though no corporal were inflicted on them, yet were they but marked so as to be known, a watchful eye might be set on them another time. One would think that your Lord and Mr could not but see the necessity off doing it and off what service it would be. This account off the battle twixt Argyle and Mar is the confused'st account sure ever was given. It sinks our joy conceived on the first report. Pray can you reconcile what became off the centre off our army? Had the first report we had come confirmed, you would have had Sea att near par this day and others in proportion. Sure I am my friend had not so much as a finger in that narrative. Will, I just long for a better account from those parts. The officers here, not one off them can reconcile it, nay even his grace's best friends. Adieu, it is past 8; pardon me for I am ...

1st 1715 Methinks tic a long time since I heard from Mr which makes me apprehend now that he has less troublesome business on his hands, that he is more sensibly affected with the late prodigious fatigues he underwent; too heavy a burden fell to his share, I am satisfied a greater than any one pair off shoulders could bear. I hope my last with an enclosed to Peter came safe. Upon the oath taken by that he was worth £20000 beyond all just demands on him, the statute formerly mentioned was suspended. However by this his will have a fair pull att him if they menage right. I am desired by Scott to know what steps you have taken towards the recovery off the £50 bill I formerly sent you. He desires you would show him no and sends me word that the rest of number ten have had a meeting this week and are resolved to prosecute him for the money due to them, which is to a considerable value. Your country with the chief off the Preston prisoners are to be to town to morrow. The inferior are distributed in several off the county goals below. I can tell you for certain that this day Mr Masterman, father to the young off that name whom you know, is appointed to go down to and take informations, not only against those that were actually in arms but all who were any ways concerned in aiding and assisting the rebels. On these informations the Attorney is to frame his prosecutions. He his credentials and instructions with recommendations to several well wishers in the country this morning and sets out this afternoon. This is very capable and zealous. There lye now att the Tower wharf six vessels from 100 to 200 ton each, on board which are to be embarked many pieces off heavy canon, 20 cohort mortars and 4 others off the largest size, proportionable ammunition off all sorts for . I hope soon after this you will see the van off the Dutch that marched hence beginning off last week. You will find Bucksnook in the utmost distress next year, they have not a friend att Gate will trust them a half penny piece. They will suffer unpitied. Adieu honest Will, take care off your health, in doing which you will oblige the public as well as ... We were yesterday to visit our Lord but he was abroad; we see his son but other company being with him we had no private confabulation.

Tuesday near 10 att night I have bin obliged to attend our board all this day and a new off our office, who invited us to dinner and with him we have bin ever since. However I can't omit adding a few friends to my good friend. You must know that I am much out off constitution, upon certain intelligence that the had not appeared so zealous upon the late disturbances as could be expected, nor my father's friends, by which it plainly appears that a certain would make his interest att court by taking all upon himself. He talks much off his indefatigable pains, such as his lying whole nights att the gates off the town ready to receive expresses as they came from this town, and giving dispatchs to the scouts he sent out whenever they returned, with much more off this nature to ingratiate himself. This a friend off ours had from a friend who heard it told to the Prince himself. This you may imagine has not a little discomposed our old after the hazard the run and his friends, besides the expensive part, that they should be reputed rather as indolent and inactive att that time off day. Poor Lord I dare say had not the least hand in this misrepresentation for he has bin in Sussex almost ever since his coming from your parts and is there yet. My father is very inquisitive after the full particulars, which as soon as come to hand shall be communicated att large. This Lord came and made a visit to my father. He expressed himself very frankly upon the matters of the north; told us that the saving off the town att first was in the greatest measure owing to the and your self, who by means off the friends off your county kept the town quiet, and expressed himself very handsomely upon that occasion. By which I perceive from what quiver the malicious arrow was shot. I read him part of your 2 letters; he desired me to draw an abstract and send him, and he would take care that your desires be answered by laying before Lord Townsend etc. He says he will make some off your people smart; he is very zealous, nay I may say extraordinary, from whence I expect something will be don. You would doe well to write to and Mr upon the subject you mention for they may be both serviceable. I can't omit mentioning one passage that happened between a of my acquaintance and another of yours and mine. Talking off the affairs off the north, he showed him several informations that he procured, among which was that against . My friend was curious to see it but he told him that it contained nothing material and so took it out off his hand. From this I conjecture many will be sunk, which is an abominable practice. I shall make the best use off your letters I can by imparting them to some I hope one time or other will make inquiry after such practices. I have not had time to consult a method for correcting the abuse committed by your being putt to the charge off shamm scoundrel packetts, but from those I have talked with their opinion is that you should seal them and return to the Post Office, who will be obliged to return you the charge. Lord was inquisitive if any officers either custom house or excise were not zealous for the , that Mr had desired to be acquainted with them and he would take care to set those matters right. Do you think if you wrote a letter to him on this subject, I dare say it would be the most effectual method of having redress. Excuse this scrawl for I am above half seas over ...

25th 1715/6 I am indicted to two off yours off no small size each, but how to discharge is the difficulty. We have had a cold sort off a thaw, which does affect me cruelly. There is no stirring abroad neither in coach, chair nor foot without manifest hazard off breaking bones, so that we are all in a great measure confined to our respective habitations; from whence you will conjecture that one has nothing to doe but answer letters, but that is not my case for I am in pain from head to foot, sick att stomach and so listless that I am not master off one clear thought, consequently fitter for bed. However before I go there will attempt to answer as far as I can your favours. Your town was unworthy off so honest a man as Jurin; as you very well remark, posterity will have reason to curse those who have had any hand in making him uneasy in the post he was possessed off. But what other can be expected from such a set off ? And to be succeeded by such a wretch, who is not worthy off wiping his shoes, is no less admirable. By this they seem resolved that the next generation shall continue in the same obscurity. Ignorance is the mother off devotion. Oh blessed church! You have named the person that poisons all and yet I wish he can be outed. Mr spoke to Lord about it but his bodily informitys disable him prodigiously from doing service to his country as well as particular friends. As to the forfeitures, you need not doubt they will be punctually and rightly applied. you have described to the life. I have pressed him by letter as well as word off mouth to send a petition drawn to the ; he pleads multiplicity off business in excuse and promises fair. Honest is as great a master in his way as was in his, with this distinction that the first does it without mask, the other picks your pocket and att the same time smiles in your face. Pray push what you can to get in that bill; if money be not to be had, had you not best return the bill to Scott? You know how I am circumstantiated in . The season for opening the trade is att hand and to be att an uncertainty att this time off day may prove off the worst consequence. I hope here this arrive that the gentlemen have come to a determination one way or other, for till I hear that would not exchange a word with the dealers. I am fully convinced that all your affairs have suffered much by your journey and especially the vend off your coals. I should have thought the whom you were serving obliged to have lent you an assisting hand but when the business is over and done the benefactor is generally forgot. This is the way off the world. Your Chester friend shows himself every day more and more in another interest. The has kissed the hand, but you may rest assured that if any thing can be made out him he will not escape. This I had from undeniable authority. I come in the next place to your bill in Chancery which bears date the 20th. I doubt you are too true a prophet concerning the . I have frequently showed that part off your letter dated the 2nd where you pointed out correctly what has since happened in relation to that . Our divisions att home have given him . The has had a watchful eye upon him. We have a fleet att sea or just ready, about ... sail, I can't say in a body as yet but you will hear off them shortly. I am off your opinion that the cruisers have not bin so diligent in their station as could be expected. We long to hear off the march off our army towards Perth, which if it please God to prosper with success will be a vast strengthening off the friends. If Sir Hotham does not represent effectually the usage some off his men have met with he does not doe justice, but as he is a man off mettle and I doubt not in the least his seeing them righted. As to the blew coat excise man, I have bin speaking till I am weary. Lately I discoursed Gale about him. Says he Mr should doe that, I am a stranger to that town and a young ; however if you would send him an information, he would out him in spite off . Had not that this man represented to him among many others? But he is a slippery spark; my father has not bin able to find out to the bottom off what he went in search off. As to the victualling and clothing , it is my admiration what interest those gentlemen have to in it. By what underhand means they work. As I take it those undertakers are generally to the by the Treasury, where I have not the least interest, having bin soliciting off salary as all in that office have had save another and my self, but without success. I about Breaks in favour off to Sir Richard Sandford last Saturday and gave him liberty to use off my fathers and my name. He did it att the House that very day to Mr Walpole, had his promise it should be done. They are so overcharged with business that none can get a minute's discourse with them but some that are their intimates. I doe my best towards improving your frequent advises to the public benefit but am much concerned that my endeavours prove off no greater use: your indefatigable pains and zeal is as good as thrown away. It happens that those people who ought to inform themselves of what passes I am a stranger too, and am apt to believe that they take all their from Lord . Were you not amazed to see in the Gazette that Lord had the address introduced by the former. I abstracted part off your letter wherein you pray that it discountenanced; left it with Lord who promised his assistance and that he would remind his father. Not ten days ago my father and self waited on the Lord , brought that subject upon the board, told him it was an affront to his that they would not accept off the association he left them; but you see to what purpose. This makes me wary off transacting matters with people that blow hot and cold. But poor man he is directed by another who never plaid a game but fast and loose. My father went this morning to the Lords to talk about the armies but came too late. Last post I see a letter from Leverpole with account that young Pearson has bin wrought upon by a who is with him to confess and has swore to as well as signed the information. Since that is, I believe they will nice off sending a copy (least it should miscarry) till after the trials. However I will attempt it. I design showing the latter part off yours about the to some friends off the House. I am perfectly jaded so fit to take a nap. 26th : this att 11 I was saluted by your last; have imparted what is most material to a particular friend, from whom I expect benefit. Adieu ... There is a flying report that to the west our men off war had taken 2 ships loaded with arms.

4th 1716 I am so taken up with phisicking night and day that I have not so much as a moment's leisure to think off business. This instant I am so grip'd that my face is enough to sower a barrel off bear, so that I don't know how to set about answering either off yours. Accept off thanks in the first place for both your favours. The proposed way cross I looked upon as next to impracticable, if it were only the difficulty off securing it against sudden floods. I can't pretend to judge off it, having only a distant idea off the situation; however by your prudent forecast in securing Anderson's and Thornley interests you have so cast their bowl off its bias that there is no prospect off its ever coming near the jack. I concluded that Silvertopp had bin so engaged with his friends in last that he would not have bin able to show his head, but he is a cunning, crafty blade. Lady though a timorous woman, yet will not part with a penny to any friend unless she have att least its worth. Old Wortley perfectly distracts her; she gives out that he is actually working 8 off her pitts in the broken mine, that he will not suffer her agent to view, that he will certainly thrust her to the vengeance. She adds that he and are two off the greatest that ever a county was blessed withal; they will by right or wrong come att means to purchase estates, but att last must go to the l. I presume the new invention you went to see is designed to be fixed above Ironside's house in the wood. The writes me word that they had sunk about 8 fathom below the coal att Farnacres and 2 att another pitt. He owns she is troublesome and expensive, but att this rate we shall loose this year before we get a pitt coal'd. Why don't we fall upon the liberty (who I rejoice is better)? The must be drained there I should think, as much as ever will be. When I am engaged I don't love to sit still. Tic above 3 weeks that I wrote to Peter for closing his books this year to clap the £260 to Coal Chamber account, which we hope sooner or later will be reimbursed. I had a letter last Monday from ; he is sadly in the miff and hup't. He wishes he had never engaged in the matter. I am sure to have my head in my hand if this bargain miscarry. Mr never sees the post but inquires if an end be not putt to the lease. Therefore must beg off you to lend your assistance in forwarding. I write to Dan this post and encourage him. I tell him that is the man I propose to take a view every 14 days in the behalf, that the charge may be 5 or 6 ; that if Weatherly would take a moderate salary as steward I thought it might not do amiss. He is used to the , knows perfectly what allowances and bargains were made with the etc. and what were the terms to be performed. If £10 or 12 would doe, he might deserve that. There is a good deal off writing etc. As to a liberty to the off leading any coals, I never did consent but for leading down that pitt which was led from the Lease and those from Hedley Fell, provided our were to be employed in the same, and no farther. I read the letter to my father and Mr as also Daniell's; they both did agree that such a liberty might enable the lessee to make our Chopwell reputation and the better to perform his bargain. Upon this the Guardian ordered me to write to the and to that purpose, but they are to be restrained from the use off the way for any other coals, save as above. When the new act comes into the house, Mr will discourse and inform his friends with the real design and I hope some way or other to get Mr possessed. My Lord has appointed a day every week for several by past to wait on Mr by this gentleman's own . When we came, the day was putt off till that day 7 night, and so from time to time till he kept his bed and I am afraid will never get abroad again. If he doe he shall see your enclosed; if not one off the Secretaries shall, though I wish to better effect. Dear friend had I had yours before had given an answer to the , your sense off the matter would have influenced me. But after having given the word, honour does oblige, though it does not a certain lady with whom you have a contest. I don't see that we shall be thanked scare for all our pains and to preserve this scurvy trade and that is but sorry wages. Adieu honest Will, let me beg off you to dispatch this lease for I shall be teased to death by the Guardian till it be don ...

10th May 1716 past 12 Yesterday was the first day I got into the Fields for a mouthful off fresh air since Tom Shafto and I walked in Kensington Gardens. I have struggled with a stout feavor ever since which still hangs upon me. I was in hopes had got the better off it but last night I did not get 2 hours sleep, and this minute the is come to visit and ordered me to swallow a dose off opium, which is don. I am extremely faint in spirit, swett vastly and in short almost dissolved. This made me lay hold off the opportunity (though my letter does not go till to morrow) least I should be disabled then, to return you my best thanks for your last as well as former , which must be ever acknowledged with a grateful sense. Yesterday was the first time I set pen to paper, when I wrote to honest Peter and enclosed him Mr James bill on you for ten days after sight. It has laid by me ever since I have bin ill. I desired him to discount it with you on account off way. is much in the miff and desires to be excused from acting further in the affair of the view off the way. This made me desire Peter that he would wait on the some day att your house, and I did not doubt but your 3 heads would be able to putt that matter upon a sure foot. He will read you what I wrote. I earnestly covett to see an end made; Mr presses upon me why I don't execute the lease. What I wrote to related to a former I wrote him a month ago att least, wherein I encouraged him to proceed; that as the was obliged to leave the way in every respect as he finds it, what had his new undertakers to apprehend if they did perform their part? If they did not design to doe it, we must come upon the lessee and he upon them. I shall be glad to hear from you. Your lines revive me much; are much more so than a cordial blister, to use the words, that Wakelin clapped on my back a foot square. I leave this open till to morrow, when you shall hear further how it fares with ... What tidings from Farnacres? Is any good to be expected; if there be I shall be agreeably balked. Adieu. 11th: I have had but another scurvy night. The feavor lies in my head and stomach and a load on my spirits. The talks off sending me to Hampstead for the air. I have bought a horse att att the pressing instance, which cost me . I don't approve of him, he trots hard and a very plain nag.

26th June 1716 I rode out off town yesterday about half a miles and dined with our friend Mr Tomson, and in the evening att my return was welcomed home by yours, which came safe and brings Scott's bill; which I was glad to see for that fellow made such a noise and complaint ffor want off it as was not to be endured. The mistake off calling it a £50 bill was soly mine. I doe assure you Mr is no stranger to your recommendation. I had employed several off my friends, att certain distance off time, to lay before him Ned 's case; nay even since his last illness got to remind him, but these great men will bide teasing. However this your last supplication by Lord I hope may prove more effectual. My father and I design waiting on his lordship to morrow where ten to one he shows me your original. I shall perhaps see Sir this afternoon and shall speak to him as you desire about Selby. This knight's son is upon the point off committing matrimony with a niece off Sir Heathcote's. The information I gave you was as I had it but since have had a more certain account; therefore you will correct it and read Pitt instead off Lady . What relates to colliery, I mean the bringing to reason the great man, deserves a due consideration; and as my father and uncle are partners it will require a joint meeting, which I shall take care off before the first leaves the town and I shall putt them both upon speaking their minds freely and openly. Your opinion off Felon and the Park, and the ability off the water catchers to perform what they undertake, is my sheet anchor in the coal trade and on what I soly depend, as also on Whickham upper seams off which I all along entertained a favourable opinion; but as to Farnacres I never could, and have not as yet any reason to alter my first conception. I have seen Sir Walter and took notice off what you recommended; he assured me it should be done. I showed likewise our friend Roger the copy off yours to Lord ; his advice was to lay it before the Board off Treasury, Mr being taken ill off his old distemper the stone. While I was discoursing that att the Grecian, in came Lord immediately took out yours which I read without taking any notice. He was att a loss what to doe. I proposed laying it before the board, which he seemed to acquiesce in and promised to doe it. There it was I met with the son off Hexham, who a letter from with an account off John Bell's death; this was so remarkable a piece that I believe if true you had not omitted it. I have made your to Sir John who it very kindly and desired to return his best thanks. The is prorogued this day to the 7th next. His I believe will set out next Thursday for Holland ...
